runbook.title: 1 · Pick an LLM provider
runbook.description: Four options: cloud provider (Google/OpenAI/Anthropic), local LLM via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or disable AI entirely.
runbook.step1: Create an API key at the provider's dashboard (e.g. Google AI Studio, OpenAI Platform, Anthropic Console). For a local LLM, install Ollama or LM Studio and run a model.
runbook.step2: For local LLMs, make sure the OpenAI-compatible endpoint is reachable from the ControlDesk server. Ollama example: `http://ollama-server:11434/v1`.
runbook.step3: Pick a model — Gemini flash for low latency, gpt-4o-mini for cost, claude-sonnet-5 for reasoning, or llama3.1:70b/qwen2.5 for on-prem.
runbook.step4: Set a daily token cap (optional) to bound cost. Default global is 10,000 output tokens per day per tenant.
runbook.step5: Fill in the form on the right. The system verifies credentials with a test call before saving.
runbook.warning: PII redaction is on by default for cloud providers — sensitive data (employee names, salary, bank account) is hashed before being sent to the LLM. For a fully self-hosted local LLM, you can disable redaction for more accurate analysis.

smtpAdmin.title: SMTP (Email)
smtpAdmin.subtitle: Per-tenant outbound email relay. Daily digests, settlement reminders, and invitation emails will be sent from your own domain (not the ControlDesk default) so the sender identity, DKIM signature, and domain reputation align with your brand.

status.noConfig: No SMTP relay registered — emails use the global default
status.hintConnected: All outbound email for this tenant flows through the relay above with the sender address you configured. Delivery history is stored in the email_outbox table.
status.hintNotConfigured: Without a custom relay, emails ship via the ControlDesk default relay with no-reply@controldesk.app as the sender. Add your relay so digests come from your own domain.

runbook.title: 1 · Prepare your SMTP relay
runbook.description: You can use any relay that speaks SMTP submission (port 587 STARTTLS or 465 SMTPS): Gmail Workspace, Zoho Mail, Postmark SMTP, AWS SES SMTP endpoint, or a self-hosted mail server.
runbook.step1: Create a mailbox or SMTP credential at your provider (e.g. no-reply@acme.com on Google Workspace, or an SMTP token on Postmark).
runbook.step2: Verify your domain at the provider — configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records in DNS so emails don't land in spam.
runbook.step3: Note the host, port, username, and password/token from the provider dashboard.
runbook.step4: Fill in the form on the right. We test the connection to the relay before saving so misconfigurations surface immediately.
runbook.step5: Once saved, all outbound email for your tenant automatically uses this relay. Come back here to rotate the password or switch relays.
runbook.warning: Store the password carefully. Once saved it's never displayed again. To rotate, paste a fresh password into this form.

form.title: Register or update the SMTP relay
form.description: On save, we verify the connection to the relay (SMTP handshake + AUTH) before persisting. If verification fails, no credentials are stored.

fields.hostHint: Hostname of the SMTP relay. Examples: smtp.gmail.com, smtp.zoho.com, smtp.postmarkapp.com.
fields.usernameHint: Typically the sender email (Gmail/Zoho) or a provider-specific username (Postmark: 'apikey', SES: SMTP IAM username).
fields.passwordHint: Email account password or provider API token. Encrypted at rest; never displayed after save.
fields.passwordHintUpdate: Leave blank to keep the current password. Paste a fresh value to rotate.
fields.fromAddressHint: Email address that appears as the sender. Must match a domain that's verified at the relay (SPF/DKIM).
fields.fromNameHint: Display name that appears in the From column. Leave blank to show only the email address.
fields.replyToHint: Address that receives replies. Leave blank to fall back to the sender (From) address.

runbook.title: 1 · Pair your device on Fonnte
runbook.description: Fonnte relays messages through a WhatsApp Web session tied to your phone. Free tier is enough for early testing.
runbook.step1: Open https://md.fonnte.com and sign up (or log in).
runbook.step2: Go to Device → Add device. Give it a name (e.g. "ControlDesk primary").
runbook.step3: Scan the QR code with WhatsApp on the phone number you want to use as the sender.
runbook.step4: Once the device shows status "connect", copy the device Token from the device list.
runbook.step5: Paste the token in the form on the right. We verify it against Fonnte before saving.

hint.title: How this works
hint.body: Blank fields inherit the global default. New submissions route through your custom values; existing in-flight items are frozen against their submit-time chain so threshold edits never re-route mid-approval.

descriptions.EXPENSE: ≥ PM threshold requires PM approval. ≥ Director threshold requires Director. Finance is always on the chain.
descriptions.BUDGET: ≥ Director threshold requires Director approval. Finance is always on the chain.
descriptions.CASH_ADVANCE_GENERAL: ≥ PM threshold requires PM. ≥ Director threshold requires Director.
descriptions.CASH_ADVANCE_FIELD_OPS: Supervisor always at rung 0. PM / OM / Director thresholds add slots as amount escalates. Settlement SLA counts from disbursed_at.
descriptions.PETTY_CASH: < Auto-approve: posts immediately. ≥ Receipt-required: receipt mandatory. > Hard ceiling: use the Expense flow instead.
descriptions.BUDGET_REQUEST: Increase / Decrease / Transfer. Threshold ladder mirrors Expense.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Analytical exports: budget vs actual, expense & cash-advance registers, petty-cash statements, project portfolio, and budget-request register.
reports.placeholderSubtitle: Pick one from the list on the left.
reports.placeholderBody: Report parameters (date range, project, status) will appear once a report is selected. Preview in-app or download directly as CSV; XLSX & PDF are coming.
reports.parametersHint: Adjust the date range and other filters, then click Preview or one of the export buttons.
reports.previewEmpty: Set filters then click Preview to load data.

portfolio.title: Project Portfolio
portfolio.description: Snapshot of all projects the caller can see, with client, PM, status, contract value, budget health, and progress %.

expenseRegister.title: Expense Register
expenseRegister.description: Every expense in the selected date range, with MA code, requester, vendor, amount, and status. Filterable by project, status, category.

caRegister.title: Cash Advance Register
caRegister.description: Cash advances in the selected date range with disbursement, expected settlement, and variance columns.

pettyCashStatement.title: Petty Cash Statement
pettyCashStatement.description: Opening balance, every posted entry, and closing balance for a fund over the selected period. Custodian-friendly month-end statement.

budgetVsActual.title: Budget vs Actual
budgetVsActual.description: Per-project · fiscal year: planned vs realized on every MA line, with outstanding advances, remaining headroom, and utilisation.

budgetRequestRegister.title: Budget Request Register
budgetRequestRegister.description: All budget-request activity in the selected date range: type (Increase/Decrease/Transfer), source MA, target MA (Transfer only), amount, and applied before → after snapshots.

bulkImport.title: Bulk import
bulkImport.subtitle: Upload Excel (.xlsx / .xls) or CSV files to create Employees, Clients, Projects, or Budget line items in batch. Every file is dry-run first — nothing is written until you click Run import.

EMPLOYEE.label: Employees
EMPLOYEE.subtitle: One row per employee. Match by email — existing employees are updated, new ones inserted. Salary and bank details stay manual per row for governance.

CLIENT.label: Clients
CLIENT.subtitle: One row per client. Match by name (case-insensitive). Sets contact + status; contracts and projects link separately.

PROJECT.label: Projects
PROJECT.subtitle: One row per project. Match by project code. Client column accepts client name, contract number, or the client's project code.

BUDGET_LINE.label: Budget line items
BUDGET_LINE.subtitle: One row per line — many lines per project/year rolled into a DRAFT budget. Cannot mutate APPROVED budgets; use the Budget Request flow instead.

history.title: Recent imports
history.empty: No imports yet. Start by picking a resource on the left.

info.governanceBody: Bulk import is restricted to HR / Finance / Admin tier. Every batch is audit-logged (BULK_IMPORT). Sensitive fields (salary, bank account, role, password) are never accepted via file — enter them per employee in the normal UI.
info.atomicBody: If any row fails validation, the whole file is rejected. Fix the file and dry-run again.
info.retainBody: Import jobs (successful and failed) are retained for postmortem — see the history table. Committed rows follow the normal audit / retention policy of the target resource.
